scope: Independent owned ImageRenderer public colorMode export/reference oracle; no Xcode workspace, display capture or product behavior

predictions.target_bytes: All opaque sRGB red/blue endpoints map exactly to little-endian float32 linear-sRGB RGBA [1,0,0,1]/[0,0,1,1] in both routes and all modes, including row padding/tail retained0xa5
predictions.control: Within each mode use fresh-renderer red/blue/red phases; final red restores exact initial destination bytes
predictions.metadata_hypothesis: colorMode may change cgImage export bpc/bpp/stride/colorSpace/bitmap flags even when fixed-destination endpoints agree. CGImage metadata is measured and compared, not assumed; provider raw bytes not captured or qualified
predictions.failure: Any target byte, callback count, dimensions, metadata shape, output wait/drain/hash or deadline disagreement rejects this expectation without relaxation or automatic native retry

failure_policy: Retain failure; no unchanged native repeat or absolute deadline extension
